text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementArtsThe Most Unsettling Books We KnowScientists and artists tell us about the book that scared them to the coreNKBy Namir Khaliq3:00 PM CDT on October 20, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThere’s no shortage of ways to unsettle yourself. The classic jump-scare or eerie monster story will do the trick. But pondering the depths of space and the extents of time, or the existential risks inherent in both technology and nature, can just as easily leave you reeling. So too can an idea that inverts your assumptions about the world and makes you question the foundations of your own reality. The unlit corners of human knowledge can feel like their own kind of lurking monster.Powered By 10 ShareNextStayThis Halloween, we offer you a dozen books recommended to us by some of our favorite scientific and artistic luminaries, each of which may fill you with both wonder and terror. While you might want to proceed with caution, our scientists and artists warn us, you will find an enriching light at the end of these 12 literary tunnels.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
